description: The plot illustrates the Loss Ratio as a function of TFLOPs for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, and tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", with a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, and tick labels at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The plot displays five lines representing different SepLLM configurations: a purple line with a star marker and solid style for an unspecified configuration, an orange line with a dash marker and solid style for SepLLM (n=64), a blue line with a square marker and solid style for SepLLM (n=128), a green line with a triangle marker and solid style for SepLLM (n=64, H), and a red line with a circle marker and solid style for SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The purple line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line starts at approximately 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 100.1% at 3e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to about 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The blue line begins at around 96.9% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to approximately 99.8% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates between 99.4% and 99.8% from 3e8 to 9e8 TFLOPs. The green line starts at about 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to around 99.8% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then remains relatively stable between 99.6% and 99.9% from 3e8 to 9e8 TFLOPs. The red line begins at approximately 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to around 98.5% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to about 98.2% at 9e8 TFLOPs, with some fluctuations in between.
